sources.title: Google Gemini 3.8 Flash model card (evals, safety, context)
sources.role: Discovery-bounded source used for factual verification

claims.text: The Gemini 3.8 Flash model card was published in September 2026, describes the model as based on Gemini 3.7 Flash, and states 1M-token multimodal input context with 64K-token text output across app, Enterprise Agent Platform, AI Studio, API, AI Mode, and Antigravity channels.
claims.context: First-party model card header and Model Information/Distribution sections consumed verbatim.

claims.text: Card-reported results excerpt: DeepSWE v1.1 73.7% (vs 65.3%), GDPVal-AA v2 Elo 1545 (vs 1482), Finance Agent v2 61.4%, Legal Agent 10.0%, Terminal-bench 2.1 89.4%, HLE-Verified 54.9%, OSWorld-2.0 partial 59.0%, CharXiv 86.2%, LVBench 87.8/87.1, with listed frontier-model comparators.
claims.context: Card-reported table excerpt; card points to a separate evals-methodology page for approach details.

claims.text: Card states known limitations (hallucinations, higher token use at high effort; knowledge cutoff March 2026 with some domains at January 2025) and safety deltas vs 3.7 Flash including slightly regressed non-English safety, plus a Frontier assessment inferring 3.8 Flash is unlikely to reach T/CCLs from 3.7 Flash results.
claims.context: Intended Usage/Limitations and safety sections as stated; inference-from-3.7 is the card's own stated basis.

claims.text: The card's eval table complements the Keyword blog but does not independently confirm it: cross-source reconciliation requires the unexamined evals-methodology page.
claims.context: Analytical bound from the card's own pointer to the evals-methodology page, which was not consumed.

limitations.text: Card evals-methodology page was not consumed, so benchmark approach, sampling, and comparator runs are unverified.
limitations.context: Evidence boundary retained for downstream editorial use.

limitations.text: All card benchmark figures are vendor-reported and externally unreproduced.
limitations.context: Evidence boundary retained for downstream editorial use.

limitations.text: Frontier no-T/CCL conclusion for 3.8 Flash is inferred from 3.7 Flash assessment, not a fresh 3.8 evaluation.
limitations.context: Evidence boundary retained for downstream editorial use.
